scope: Proposition 2.2 (Patch obstruction) of the manuscript “A Smooth Metric with No Local Isometric Immersion into Three-Space” (preprints/A-Smooth-Metric-with-No-Local-Isometric-Immersion-into-Three-Space-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 334 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 6c2cf05d89a23473), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 4. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The metrics in U admitting no admissible height form a residual subset of U. In particular, for every C∞ neighborhood of g0 in U, there is a metric in that neighborhood with no admissible height.
